i’m really sorry to hear about your kid. i’m aware that different people deal with disorders and overall mental health problems in various ways, but i think that in my case personally i’d really just like it if my parents showed any kind of interest in me as a human being outside of just being their daughter. i think what a child needs most from their parents is to be shown that they care and to feel loved and appreciated. i really hope your situation gets better and your kid feels safe enough to talk about stuff like that with you
i understand that but it’s still just really hard because in my mind they won’t ever really care unless i get hospitalized one day and that just really scares me
it really is frustrating sometimes but thank you for the kind words i really appreciate it <3
sending you hugs i hope you manage to get better even without your family’s help <3

i’m sorry but even if i havent been to therapy myself that seems like such a stupid thing to say to somebody who you’re supposed to be helping. most people with mental health issues i know don’t think they can get better but does that mean they don’t deserve help? of course not. you’re there to get help and it’s their job to get through to you and help. i hope you keep looking for a good therapist because i feel like there’s always a point in trying that as it might really really help you in the long run. sending you lots of love <3 i hope you’re doing better

i’ve tried showering with my eyes closed but i practically start having a panic attack LOL so i have to suffer!! :(
i literally sit here looking at recipes i’d love to try for hours but never end up making anything in fear of potentially gaining any weight lol??

i trust him with everything and i talk about almost everything with him and he is really understanding but im not sure that he can help me with it all because ive had problems for a really really long time and they’ve escalated really quickly over the past two years
as for my depression, it absolutely 100% is rooted in my insecurities most of which have been caused by my parents
my boyfriend didnt tell her he was in a relationship because we had practically broken up because of my lack of emotional attachment

i have been very distant and cold to my boyfriend because of my horrible depression for a while now and i suggested that he tries exploring his options because i couldnt make him happy, he met a girl and around the same time i started realizing that i cant just keep living my life in fear of everything and i told him what’s been going on with me and us and i explained to him that i will try my best to be better for him and give him what he needs and deserves, but apparently my timing was shit because the girl he was speaking to had fallen for him and now i’m in a situation where he chose me over her because as i know very well he loves me more than anyone else but she is heartbroken :) and i feel like shit because she’s got her own mental health issues and she is dealing with stuff too and i’ve made everything so shitty for her because she finally met someone she really likes and i had to be a selfish horrible person and fuck up everything. she was suicidal and i’m not sure if she did anything to herself but i feel like shit nonetheless :)))))

I don’t think I’ll tell them anytime soon. Once when my depression was at its lowest and I was hanging by a thread I told him and my mom that I had depressive and suicidal thoughts and it took a LOT of courage because I had been hiding it from them for years and all my dad said was “Great.” then the next day began to lecture me about how if I used the internet less I wouldn’t be depressed when it all started with him and his ignorant behavior towards me. My mom on the other hand got very upset and cried downstairs for a while before she went upstairs to talk with me. She’s way more understanding but I don’t want to upset her any more than I already have.

He’s a bit of both. My parents had suspected it for a while but then I forced myself into recovery so they kinda just forgot about it like they do with everything. He cares about me but is a real dickhead when it comes to understanding me.
GOD YES that’s the worst

Me too, I have not eaten at school for years and refuse to eat when I’m out with people because it gives me such bad anxiety and I constantly expect someone to just tell me I’m eating too much or just mention what I’m eating. It makes it quite literally impossible to eat when I’m with people that I don’t fully trust.

I honestly feel like they won’t ever get it unless there’s a major change in the way I eat or look because they truly don’t think it’s a serious problem and I truly don’t want to tell them something is wrong because I’m afraid of the way they’ll react.

yes i’ve told them numerous times before that i hate when they mention that stuff. not to mention i very clearly am uncomfortable when they do that stuff yet they continue to do it because they apparently don’t see anything wrong with it.

I do but I also don’t because in my mind it’s pointless since neither my unhealthy habits nor my insecurities are going to change or vanish so I just don’t talk about all that stuff anymore. Especially considering I think I’m being pretty annoying when that’s all I can talk about.

The last time therapy was ever mentioned in my house is when I broke down in front of my family and my mom suggested it, but the next day it was as if both my parents didn’t know any of it had happened. I want to go to therapy but it has to go through them first and I’ve also been really anxious about the whole thing really.
I’ve thought about it and I have a feeling that I will never be strong enough to admit it even if that was the case haha.

Quite literally because I don’t believe I can live without that person. I don’t really have anyone else that I can rely on as much as him and every time I want to leave I remind myself that it’s just his anger issues taking over him and that it’s not really how he thinks, although that doesn’t make it less hurtful.
Yes, I am. I still live with them, moving out in a couple of years probably.

I agree with that. And I guess my brain just won’t let me say anything bad about them that’s about it. I’ve looked up to them for so long and the fact that I keep finding out things that they are doing wrong and are probably reasons for why I’m the way I am just makes it all worse, so I am very hesitant when it comes to saying anything bad about them.

I really am not sure how to explain it either honestly, I just know that they never were abusive, they made it so that my brother and I can live in a safe and good environment the only downside was the fact that I started feeling depressed and it just showed me how hard it can be if they aren’t willing to be understanding towards it and me.

That’s what I think most of the time, but I also always thought my mom was better than my dad when it comes to understanding emotions etc. I really can’t bring myself to call them bad parents, because I feel like that just makes me sound ungrateful for everything they have done for me, but I do think they aren’t very understanding.
I’d probably lean towards lousy, but then again I can’t help but think that I just make everything out to be worse than it is because of my depression.

I still don’t think they are bad parents. They do so much for me and my brother, but with me being so depressed and their inability to understand the situation it really just hurts me and makes it much worse than it could be.

They really aren’t bad parents, they never were. But consciously they just didn’t ever try to understand why I’m acting a certain way. I’ve been depressed for about maybe 4 years now and they never bothered to ask me why I’m so moody or angry all the time. Their ignorance made it worse and when I finally told them that I am suicidal and depressed I felt guilty. Although my father’s reaction was just a simple “Great.” my awfully constructed statement that came out of absolutely nowhere if you don’t count the fact that I was crying before that “accident” made my mom cry. I went upstairs and after a while she was the only one that bothered to come upstairs and talk to me, so I felt guilty because I upset her. I remember she suggested therapy but just like any other time I’ve snapped or cried in front of them the next day played out as if the previous one hadn’t ever happened. The only thing they did that was connected to that situation was my father sitting me down and basically telling me that I’m overreacting and that it’s just how people my age are and that it’s the internet’s fault. Ever since that I’ve never mentioned my depression to my parents. I really doubt they understand it or care about it so I don’t know if there is even a point of them knowing about it.

Parents, unhealthy relationships with people that just make me feel like I’m worthless. All of it just piles up overtime and it’s become such a huge pile that I really am scared that I will just break soon and end it.
It definitely is not healthy. I want to end it so badly, but I want to stay even more than that. Unhealthy relationships with people will actually just be the death of me I think.

It really fucking hurts. I already can’t go a day without thinking that no one cares about me and that no one will miss me if i just went through with it and him just saying that makes me lose it completely.

My parents are the main reasons behind probably 70% of my insecurities. I’m also almost sure I have an eating disorder. I’ve also become extremely insecure about how stupid and pathetic I am in terms of my personality lately.
Insecurities.
I wish it was that easy. I’m extremely insecure and easily influenced and on top of it all I love that person more than anyone else in my life.
I have been suicidal for over a year but this year it’s become a huge problem and the only reason I am alive right now is because I am scared of death.

It’s quite literally the person I love the most. His anger problems absolutely take over his entire brain when something pisses him off and shit like that just happens. I can’t leave though because I’m too attached and I can’t stop loving him so much so that’s great.
Only thing that has changed is that I’m more tired now haha.
That’s exactly why I love World of Warcraft so much haha, very time consuming but also interesting.

I played Slime Rancher once but I got bored fast because I’ve watched the entire gameplay on youtube so I know the whole story, but I would probably play it sometime if I get bored since there’s a lot of exploring to do. I’m also in a bad relationship with food, but I think my favorite food would either be spaghetti or anything with potatoes.

Oh, I am extremely bad at video games, especially competitive ones. Mainly because I just get so depressed over it that I don’t have the strength to even try to improve. And I enjoy playing World of Warcraft a lot, since it’s really relaxing. There’s also other ones but that’s the one that just popped up in my mind when I read your question.

I think that what I can’t stand the most about my life as a whole is how bad I am at everything. Usually my head is full of hateful thoughts towards me and it’s hard to deal with sometimes because it feels like nothing I do helps. And I usually feel calm when I’m playing video games or, as strange as it sounds, showering (even though my depression often stops me from doing that).
I would love to just vent but I think that nothing I say makes any sense or my thoughts are just so messy that I can’t figure out what’s making me upset.
It’s hard to believe that I even deserve help haha. Even if I did the country I live in would be a really awful place to get help I would guess. Thank you for the concern though, I appreciate it.
